summary: Tested SAP On-Hand Inventory netting feature added to Purchasing Plan (backend pytest against live target_month=2020-01 fast path, plus full browser automation of the frontend flow incl. generate, stat cards, table columns, sorting, category totals, Excel export, category filter regression). All requested behaviors verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: purchasing_plan.py: net_qty_by_month correctly falls back to a copy of qty_by_month when on_hand_qty is None (never-stocked component) - verified both in code and visually in UI ('—' On-Hand cell, Net Qty == Gross Qty).

Netting formula max(0, gross-on_hand) confirmed both via backend pytest (7/7 passed, checked across all components/months with on_hand present) and visually in UI/Excel export, e.g. component 'ING': on_hand=1039.143, gross=1430.5, net=391.357 = round(1430.5-1039.143,4) - exact match.

sap_inventory_client.py: sensible, well-documented pagination via $top/$skip and deliberate avoidance of $select (documented empirical SAP quirk) - best-effort try/except around get_on_hand_stock() call in purchasing_plan.py prevents a SAP inventory hiccup from failing the whole plan, consistent with existing costs lookup pattern.

Frontend correctly shows both Gross and Net as separate stat cards/columns/totals (per user's explicit choice, not a replace) - verified 'GROSS VALUE - JAN 2020' and 'NET PURCHASE VALUE - JAN 2020' stat cards both render with correct independent values.

Net columns are visually distinguished with light blue background/text (#E5F0FA/#004B87 headers, #F5FAFF/#004B87 cells) consistently across headers, data rows, and category group totals - matches spec.

Column sorting works correctly for new fields: verified Total Net Value header toggles asc/desc (row order changed as expected, caret icon updates), On-Hand and month Net Qty headers clickable without errors.

Excel export verified via direct xlsx XML inspection (not just headers) - 'Purchasing Plan' sheet contains Product ID/Description/Category/UOM/On-Hand Inventory/{Month} Gross Qty/{Month} Net Purchase Qty/{Month} Gross Value/{Month} Net Value/Total Gross Value/Total Net Value columns, with cell values matching the on-screen table exactly (spot-checked 'ING' row).

Category group header rows aggregate On-Hand, Net Qty, Net Value, and Net Grand Total consistently with child row sums (spot-checked 'Copper Alloy' category total Net Value = 396,440.73 which equals the single non-zero child row 'ING' 396,440.73, others being 0).

Regression check passed: category filter dropdown, expand/collapse categories, missing BOMs warning banner, BOM data freshness badge, AI category grouping (category names vary slightly run-to-run due to AI categorization non-determinism e.g. 'Copper' vs 'Copper Alloy' split - this is an existing/known AI-categorizer characteristic from prior sessions, not a regression introduced this session).

Minor observation (not a bug): live SAP on-hand inventory values changed between consecutive 'Regenerate' clicks within the same test run (some rows had on_hand=null/'—' on one run, populated values on the next) - expected since this queries a live, real-time external SAP tenant snapshot each time, exactly as documented in the review request.
test_credentials: N/A - no app-level auth; SAP/OMS/Mongo creds used as-is from backend/.env per review request.
seed_data_creation: None - used live SAP/OMS data via target_month=2020-01 (established fast-path month from prior iterations, ~18 components).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This session's inventory-netting feature is fully verified end-to-end (backend math + frontend rendering/sorting/export). Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_purchasing_plan_inventory.py added as a reusable regression asset using target_month=2020-01 (fast, ~18 components, avoids the 3-5min full live run). Note: on-hand inventory values are a live real-time SAP snapshot so exact figures/which components have data will vary run to run - tests are designed to be data-value-agnostic (formula checks, not hardcoded expected numbers) so this is safe for future re-runs.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found this session.
